original_test_intent: Inject one correctable MP5 error at the intended CCD and firmware index, verify a fresh MP5-specific corrected event without reset or escalation, then prove CCD compute and MP5-managed services remain healthy.
original_method: Map MP5, socket and CCD instances; validate errormode2/index0/mcapolling0/errortype0; preserve raw state/log baseline; inject once; correlate exactly one fresh MP5 CE; check no reset/UCE and verify CCD cores, NUMA, sensors and workload health; restore all temporary RAS/HDT settings.
manual_activity: The FAE maps MP5 to CCD0, approves the tuple, runs one CE injection, watches for escalation and restores controller, compute and RAS state.
required_inputs: MP5 controller-to-socket/CCD/core/NUMA map and required coverage
Vendor semantics for errormode2, CCD0, enablemcapolling0, errorindex0 and errortype0
FFE threshold and SMU/PSP-debug-disable relevance with raw restoration values
Exact MP5 CE source/severity/count and no-reset/no-UCE acceptance
Supported OS and timeout plus CCD compute, NUMA, sensor and firmware-service limits
Abort, recovery, cleanup and BIOS/HDT restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated monitored SUT with independent console and stable power/thermal state
Baseline CCD topology, MP5 telemetry and error counters
Inject once only after exact controller/index mapping
Abort on reset, UCE, missing core/NUMA node, firmware/sensor failure, thermal anomaly or wrong source
No automatic retry; restore settings and prove zero persistent error
agent_execution_scope: Validate topology, tuple, CE oracle, timeout and recovery checks
Collect read-only settings, exact event fields, CPU/NUMA topology, telemetry and workload health
Do not choose CCD/index, change BIOS/HDT, inject, reset, recover, retry or decide verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broad MP1/MP5/firmware-error grep cannot bind errorindex0 to MP5 CCD0, count a fresh CE or demonstrate no escalation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping approval, run one MP5 CE and require exact source/count, no reset/UCE, and unchanged CCD/NUMA and firmware-service health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: socket0, errormode2, CCD0, enablemcapolling0, errorindex0, errortype0, FFE threshold, three OS families and 15/10-minute values remain preserved but gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a topology-bound single MP5 CE with exactly-one-event/no-reset acceptance and before/after CCD plus firmware-service health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds MP5/CCD mapping, event count, negative escalation, topology health and raw rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tool PASS and a generic corrected line do not prove MP5/CCD targeting or absence of degradation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong tuple may reset the host, impair a CCD or disrupt firmware-managed power and thermal behavior.

project_override_considerations: If more than one CCD or socket is populated, CCD0/socket0 requires an explicit representativeness or expansion decision; never infer that one firmware index covers every die.
expected_evidence: MP5-to-socket/CCD/core/NUMA map and approved tuple semantics
Exact injection transcript with no-reset timeline
Exactly one fresh MP5 CE MCA/CPER/WHEA/SEL record and zero UCE delta
Unchanged core/NUMA enumeration, sensors, power/thermal behavior and bounded workload

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The CE title, errortype0 and applicable tool-PASS branch align. The generic UCE branch can be treated as escalation text, but platform-specific tuple, coverage and acceptance details remain incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: MP5 CE intent and literal command are identifiable; engineering inputs gate execution rather than static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 83 Wistron-System RAS-00803-V003: map MP5 to socket/CCD/core/NUMA and define smupsp errormode2/CCD0/enablemcapolling0/errorindex0/errortype0 semantics; approve socket/CCD coverage, FFE and debug-setting relevance, exact fresh CE/no-reset/no-UCE fields, OS timeout, compute/NUMA/sensor/power/thermal health, aborts and full restoration.

review_improvement: Adds MP5/CCD-specific attribution, bounded CE count and negative escalation plus compute and firmware health checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike MP1 mode, this tuple explicitly names CCD0 and errormode2, implying a die-local MP5 path that must be mapped rather than assumed. A correctable report is only meaningful if it is fresh, singular and tied to the intended controller, while the targeted CCD and firmware-managed services remain stable. The sibling UCE behavior cannot define the CE pass condition.
